review_depth: Source abstracts, methodological descriptions and named repository reports; not a systematic full-text review

works.title: Bayesian Multilevel Estimation with Poststratification
works.method: Fit cell-level opinion and poststratify by measured population counts.
works.translation_to_repo: Implement only after respondent data, cell counts, weights and validation are acquired.
works.boundary: State-level success does not establish Pasadena accuracy.

works.title: Using Multilevel Regression and Poststratification to Estimate Dynamic Public Opinion
works.method: Partial pooling across geography and time.
works.translation_to_repo: Separate a dynamic opinion layer from material-condition factors.
works.boundary: Public toplines alone cannot identify respondent-cell interactions.

works.title: Disentangling Bias and Variance in Election Polls
works.method: Separate election-level shared bias from poll-specific variance.
works.translation_to_repo: Use cycle/state/source covariance in poll likelihood; estimate on historical vintages.
works.boundary: Reported sampling margins do not cover all survey error.

works.title: An Updated Dynamic Bayesian Forecasting Model for the U.S. Presidential Election
works.method: Correlated state trends, house/population/mode effects and national errors.
works.translation_to_repo: Reimplement open methodological components in Rust; no proprietary prior values or code presumed.
works.boundary: Presidential model is not a validated local, legislative or multi-domain model.

works.title: Grappling With Uncertainty in Forecasting the 2024 U.S. Presidential Election
works.translation_to_repo: Retain model-class sensitivity alongside sampling and posterior intervals.
works.boundary: Single-cycle outcome cannot validate probability calibration.

works.title: Macroeconomic Nowcasting and Forecasting with Big Data
works.method: Dynamic factors and real-time release processing.
works.translation_to_repo: Mixed-frequency state-space observation layer; ragged edges and vintage replay.
works.boundary: Economic factor loadings do not automatically transfer to political states.

works.title: New York Fed Staff Nowcast methodological FAQ
works.method: Bayesian dynamic factor/Kalman layer with mixed-frequency releases and changing volatility.
works.translation_to_repo: Use as a reference design, not a verbatim clone; implement typed Rust components after EDA.
works.boundary: Proprietary input series prevent exact public replication of published nowcast.

works.title: Opportunity Insights Economic Tracker documentation
works.method: Private-source aggregate spending by resident location, with documented breaks and revisions.
works.translation_to_repo: Per-series adapter with provider attribution, units, geography basis and break flags.
works.boundary: No transaction microdata, cash-complete coverage or merchant-location equivalence.

works.title: EI: A Program for Ecological Inference
works.method: Distinguish aggregate observations from assumptions about individual behavior.
works.translation_to_repo: Use bounds/sensitivity if aggregate behavioral decomposition is attempted.
works.boundary: Never identify individual political preferences from neighborhood demographics.

works.title: A meta-analysis of state-of-the-art electoral prediction from Twitter data
works.method: Audit population bias, method selection and weak forecast benchmarks.
works.translation_to_repo: Keep social media as an attention/stance layer; validate against surveys and simple forecasts.
works.boundary: Post volume and sentiment do not constitute representative polling.

works.title: Do Our Social Networks Influence Our Expectations of Inflation?
works.translation_to_repo: Candidate exposure-weighted interaction between measured gas shocks and expectations.
works.boundary: A network association is not a proved local political causal effect.

works.title: Crossing-detector statistical benefit and operational utility
works.method: Small archive gain below declared useful target; generic sign controls often match/exceed canonical.
works.translation_to_repo: Require matched history, fixed-support ensembles and generic cubic controls in political tests.
works.boundary: Do not promote algebra-specific advantage from historical 32D notes.

works.title: Research epistemics
works.method: Separate source propositions, implementation conformance and phenomenological mappings.
works.translation_to_repo: Enumerate maps, fitted parameters, falsifiers and abandonment criteria.
works.boundary: A source analogy or successful hardware run cannot establish political validity.

terms: pooled dataset (inspect schema; does not necessarily mean aggregate-only statistics)
